quotes.text: In D210781 the first focus assertion did not fail when the production focus call was removed. The reviewer found that the old clear-button click emulation was wrong and asked for the assertion in test_clearButton, plus checks of the host activeElement and shadow-root input. The landed test uses BrowserTestUtils.synthesizeMouseAtCenter on the clear button and waits for render before checking focus. This is a review rule for interaction tests: exercise the user action and verify the test detects the regression.
